title: A byte order mark inside a literal block scalar
notes: The content of a literal scalar is made of non-break characters, and production 27 excludes the byte order mark, so a mark in the middle of a content line is an error. It is the first character that cannot belong: line 2, column 4 (two spaces, `x`, then the mark). The comment form is diagnostics/bom-in-a-comment-is-an-error.

provenance.reference: A reader that accepted a byte order mark in the text of a block scalar.
